Key to the Orders of Arachnida

Source: R/keys.R
arachnida.Rd

The key from Triplehorn & Johnson (2005), Borror and DeLong's Introduction to the Study of Insects, 7th ed., chapter 5, as a table of leads (see keyFromLeads()); arachnidaKey() turns it into a dimoose key. Transcribed by hand from the book.

Usage

arachnida

Format

A data frame with 22 rows (11 couplets) and 6 columns:

Statement

Couplet number.

Choice

a for the first lead (1.), b for the second (1'.).

Character

Text of the lead.

Next

Couplet the lead leads to, or "-".

Taxon

Order the lead ends in, for terminal leads.

Page

Page of the book where that order is treated.

Source

Triplehorn CA, Johnson NF (2005). Borror and DeLong's Introduction to the Study of Insects, 7th ed. Thomson Brooks/Cole. Transcription: data-raw/arachnida/ in the package sources.
